title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: Expresses its profound solidarity with the children of Ukraine and with the families separated from them through Russia’s war of aggression; commends the dedication of Ukrainian and international civil society organisations, which, alongside victims’ families and often at personal risk, have documented abductions, maintained verified identity registries, rescued children from Russia and the temporarily occupied territories, and have supported their reintegration;
